consumer: The optician fitted lenses with a different prescription and wants me to pay for another pair.

I paid for a parcel to be collected from my office. The courier marked it collected, but it is still here.

A repair technician collected my sewing machine and now demands a call-out fee we never discussed.
The bus company sold me a seat on a trip they cancelled and will only offer a voucher I cannot use.

I transferred a repayment to the number on my statement but the lender has applied it to the wrong account.

other: The landlord told us to move by Friday because he plans to convert the block to offices. Our rental agreement runs to December.

My ex and I disagree on who can pick our daughter up from school during the week.
